system.description:
You are treated as having the "Mobility Attack" "Lightning Step" with SR +1 (it is acceptable to exceed the maximum SR). The movement distance of the "Ritardando" you use is +1Sq. Legion Cloak Legendary battlefield poet's favored cloak. Lightened by magic and with a unique structure, it provides maximum effectiveness in maneuverable tactics.

Breaker's Warband[Core Material](220G)+Chain Tunic(490G)+[Magic Catalyst 10](110G)×3+Crafting Cost(410G)
